settings.label: Wall server
settings.help: Where the global caller list comes from. The same server GWall uses.

settings.label: Connect timeout (seconds)
settings.help: How long to wait for the wall server before giving up. A caller sits through this.

settings.label: Working file
settings.help: Where the door parks the JSON it fetched while it draws. An AmigaDOS path: t: is the emulator's temporary assign.

settings.label: Lines to display
settings.help: AUTO uses the caller's own screen length, which is what a door should do. A number overrides it for every caller alike.

settings.label: Clear the screen first

choices.label: No - draw under what is there

settings.help: Whether to wipe the screen before drawing the list, or let it scroll under whatever the caller was looking at.

settings.label: Style
settings.help: Four layouts, 1 to 4 - two headers and two footers. A comma-separated list picks one of them at random each time, which is why this board ships 1,4,3.

settings.label: Timezone
settings.help: Used to print call times. Windows timezone naming, not IANA - "W. Europe Standard Time", not "Europe/Stockholm". The board sends it with every posted call and reads the list in it.
